description: Gather information about EC2 ENI interfaces in AWS.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: eni_id
parameters.description: The ID of the ENI. This option is mutually exclusive of filters.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: A dict of filters to apply. Each dict item consists of a filter key and a filter value. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeNetworkInterfaces.html for possible filters. This option is mutually exclusive of eni_id. Default: {}

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

# Gather information about all ENIs
- amazon.aws.ec2_eni_info:

# Gather information about a particular ENI
- amazon.aws.ec2_eni_info:
    filters:
      network-interface-id: eni-xxxxxxx

return_values.name: network_interfaces
return_values.description: List of matching elastic network interfaces. Returned: always

return_values.name: association
return_values.description: Info of associated elastic IP (EIP). Returned: When an ENI is associated with an EIP Sample: {"allocation_id": "eipalloc-5sdf123", "association_id": "eipassoc-8sdf123", "ip_owner_id": "123456789012", "public_dns_name": "ec2-52-1-0-63.compute-1.amazonaws.com", "public_ip": "52.1.0.63"}

return_values.name: attachment
return_values.description: Info about attached ec2 instance. Returned: When an ENI is attached to an ec2 instance Sample: {"attach_time": "2017-08-05T15:25:47+00:00", "attachment_id": "eni-attach-149d21234", "delete_on_termination": false, "device_index": 1, "instance_id": "i-15b8d3cadbafa1234", "instance_owner_id": "123456789012", "network_card_index": 0, "status": "attached"}

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: Availability zone of ENI. Returned: always Sample: "us-east-1b"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Description text for ENI. Returned: always Sample: "My favourite network interface"

return_values.name: groups
return_values.description: List of attached security groups. Returned: always Sample: [{"group_id": "sg-26d0f1234", "group_name": "my_ec2_security_group"}]

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: The id of the ENI (alias for network_interfaces.network_interface_id). Returned: always Sample: "eni-392fsdf"

return_values.name: interface_type
return_values.description: Type of the network interface. Returned: always Sample: "interface"

return_values.name: ipv6_addresses
return_values.description: List of IPv6 addresses for this interface. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: mac_address
return_values.description: MAC address of the network interface. Returned: always Sample: "0a:f8:10:2f:ab:a1"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The Name tag of the ENI, often displayed in the AWS UIs as Name. Returned: When a Name tag has been set

return_values.name: network_interface_id
return_values.description: The id of the ENI. Returned: always Sample: "eni-392fsdf"

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: AWS account id of the owner of the ENI. Returned: always Sample: "123456789012"

return_values.name: private_dns_name
return_values.description: Private DNS name for the ENI. Returned: always Sample: "ip-172-16-1-180.ec2.internal"

return_values.name: private_ip_address
return_values.description: Private IP address for the ENI. Returned: always Sample: "172.16.1.180"

return_values.name: private_ip_addresses
return_values.description: List of private IP addresses attached to the ENI. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: requester_id
return_values.description: The ID of the entity that launched the ENI. Returned: success Sample: "AIDA12345EXAMPLE54321"

return_values.name: requester_managed
return_values.description: Indicates whether the network interface is being managed by an AWS service. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: source_dest_check
return_values.description: Indicates whether the network interface performs source/destination checking. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Indicates if the network interface is attached to an instance or not. Returned: always Sample: "in-use"

return_values.name: subnet_id
return_values.description: Subnet ID the ENI is in. Returned: always Sample: "subnet-7bbf01234"

return_values.name: tag_set
return_values.description: Dictionary of tags added to the ENI. Returned: always Sample: {}

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Dictionary of tags added to the ENI. Returned: always Sample: {}

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: ID of the VPC the network interface it part of. Returned: always Sample: "vpc-b3f1f123"
